about.description: The Flora-Bama Yacht Club has become almost as legendary as the bar across the street. A legendary waterfront restaurant in Orange Beach known for original menu items, local seafood, award-winning chefs, live music, and outdoor deck with beach area.

menu.name: Seared Yellowfin Tuna Sashimi
menu.description: Yellowfin tuna with Creole wasabi, Sriracha mayo and hoisin.

menu.name: Gulf Coast Blue Crab Claws
menu.description: Half pound of blue crab claws either fried or sautéed in our lemon cream sauce.

menu.name: Smoked Tuna Dip
menu.description: Fresh local tuna, hardwood smoked, served with specialty crackers.

menu.name: Firecracker Calamari
menu.description: Panko-fried calamari drizzled in our house firecracker aioli and sweet chili sauce.

menu.name: Greek Shrimp Nachos
menu.description: Fried wonton chips smothered in a spinach and feta cream sauce topped with grilled American shrimp, tomatoes, crumbled feta, Kalamata olives, peppadews, banana peppers, green onion and red onion.

menu.name: Crab & Parmesan Hash Puppies
menu.description: Deep-fried hashbrowns, local blue crab and mashed potatoes folded with Parmesan and Créole seasoning served with chipotle bacon ranch.

menu.name: Greek Chicken Flatbread
menu.description: Greek marinated chicken, spinach and feta cream sauce, feta cheese, and Greek marinated vegetables on a crispy flatbread.

menu.name: Firecracker Coconut Shrimp
menu.description: Coconut-crust American shrimp topped with our in-house firecracker aioli and sweet chili sauce.

menu.name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
menu.description: The savory flavors of roasted red peppers and ground chickpeas. Served with grilled pita bread.

menu.name: Asian Ahi Tuna Nachos
menu.description: Crispy wontons topped with ahi tuna, sweet soy glaze, wasabi cucumber aioli, shredded Asian slaw and spicy mayo.

menu.name: Yacht Club Char-Grilled Oysters
menu.description: Char-grilled oysters topped with our world famous Orleans cream, Parmesan cheese and garlic butter.

menu.name: Bienville Oysters
menu.description: Char-grilled Oysters topped with a creole shrimp sauce, diced bacon, green onions and parmesan cheese.

menu.name: Oyster Sampler
menu.description: 3 oyster each of Oysters McClellan, Chargrilled , Rockefeller and Bienville.

menu.name: Raw Gulf Oysters
menu.description: Fresh oysters served on the half shell.

menu.name: Oysters Rockefeller
menu.description: Char-grilled oysters topped with creamy Rockefeller sauce.

menu.name: Oysters McClellan
menu.description: The Flora-Bama's original grilled oyster! Gulf oysters topped with green onion, bacon, and melted smoked gouda.

menu.name: Our World Famous Gumbo
menu.description: Traditional roux based gumbo with house made shrimp stock. Loaded with Conecuh sausage and American shrimp.

specials.name: Daily Specials
specials.description: Daily specials made with fresh seasonal ingredients. Ask your server about our daily specials.
